annotations.title: Every standard VAT rate a country has had

description: List every standard VAT rate one EU member state has had since 2016-01-01, with the first day each one applied. Use this for "how has the VAT rate in Ireland changed?". Standard VAT rates only (not reduced rates), from 2016-01-01. Data checked against the published rates on 2026-10-04; a change made after that date appears in a newer release.

country.description: EU member state code such as "DE" or "FR" (case does not matter). Greece is "EL"; "GR" is accepted too.
